source.attribution: Barczak, A. L. C.; Reyes, N. H.; Abastillas, M.; Piccio, A.; Susnjak, T. (2011), A new 2D static hand gesture colour image dataset for ASL gestures, Research Letters in the Information and Mathematical Sciences, 15, 12-20
source.condition_metadata: Filename codes bot, top, left, right and dif identify light direction, not physical hand or camera angle. JPEG mirror of the original segmented images; no explicit physical-hand/session annotations.

selection.method: SHA-256 filename order within source/signer/letter (and light direction when documented)
